# Perfect Entry — Forex Trading Tools and Education
# https://perfectentry.store

## About
Perfect Entry is a forex trading tools and education company founded in April 2020, operated by Perfect Entry FZ-LLC (Dubai, RAKEZ). We provide TradingView indicators, a free AI session screener, live signals dashboard, and rule-based trading education to over 14,000 traders worldwide.

## Free Tools
- AI Session Screener: https://perfectentry.store/screener.html
  Shows which of 29 forex pairs are inside their statistically validated trading windows in real time. Based on 65,000+ backtested trades. No login required, free forever.

- Reversal Sniper Data: https://perfectentry.store/data.html
  Full backtesting dataset with win rates by pair, timeframe, and confidence score. Publicly available.

- Live Signals Dashboard: https://perfectentry.store/signals.html
  Real-time forex signals with entry, SL, TP and pip calculations.

## Membership
Market Master membership at https://whop.com/perfect-entry/ includes all TradingView indicators, full education, and access to the live signals dashboard.

## Methodology
Session windows are derived from 65,000+ raw trades validated using 4-way out-of-sample testing. Confidence scores (S1-S4 for short timeframes, HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW for longer) reflect how many OOS quarters a window passed.
